node.title: Re^3: split on spaces, except those within quotes?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I believe that line is supposed to be s/(('|").*?\2)/ ($£ = $1) =~ s!\s+!\cA!g; $£ /ge;. AFAICT, the nonstandard $£ is just supposed to be a scratch variable, so you can replace it with e.g. $a (assuming there's no [doc://sort] in the call stack) or a lexical of your choosing.

However, note [BrowserUk]'s words: "I probably deserve hate mail for this one but..." - see e.g. [mod://Regexp::Common::delimited] or [doc://Text::Balanced].
